what_this_is: The row that runs the module tests of a commit of the Rust engine repository after it lands, on the person's own computer. It never refuses or reverts a push: it writes one calendar finding per failing test filter, names the commit and its lane, and closes the finding when the filter passes again.

payload.label: Run the tests of what landed on the Rust engine
payload.job: After a commit of the Rust engine lands, run the test filters of the modules it changed and open or close a finding
payload.description: Takes since (the commit before the landing) and commit (the landed commit). Maps each changed .rs path to its cargo test filter (read-data/module-map.json, DATA), runs each filter on an export of the commit with a time cap, and writes findings: red filters open a calendar finding assigned to the lane named in the commit's Lane trailer, and a finding closes when its filter passes. A cap-out is unknown, never a pass. Never refuses a push.

cli.description: The command the calling site uses to call its own tools (its path on the computer).

database.description: The name of the database the findings are written to.

needs: a checkout of the Rust engine repository named in read-data/module-map.json
invoke.say: Runs on the person's computer, never on the hosted service. Run it with the two commits, then tell the person each filter's status and any finding it opened or closed.
